create_agent: create a DQN Agent instance with batch size, optimizer name, optimizer kwargs, and initial cumulant weight
step_agent: call step on the Agent to select random actions during training or return regressed weights during evaluation
update_agent: call update on the Agent with environment transitions to accumulate replay and trigger gradient descent when batch is full
get_logs_agent: call get_logs on the Agent to retrieve the current regressed cumulant weight values as a dictionary
review_agent_class: review the Agent class that regresses cumulant weights via TensorFlow gradient descent to predict rewards
